name: Seraiah (a Simeonite)
title: A link in the genealogy of the tribe of Simeon
summary: Seraiah, son of Asiel, was a link among the heads of the tribe of Simeon and an ancestor of Jehu mentioned in the genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Seraiah, son of Asiel, is listed in the genealogy of the heads of Simeon.
